column2: Retain Antiochus son of Demetrius, sea islands, Simon’s priest/ethnarch titles and the whole nation. This patronymic distinguishes the new claimant from the young Antiochus killed earlier.
Retain the royal greeting and great-priest/ethnarch titles. The address is human diplomatic correspondence, without sacred second-person forms.
Retain pestilent men, ancestral kingdom, intended restoration, mercenary recruitment and warships. The disease metaphor is the speaker’s description, not a medical claim.
Retain intended landing and pursuit of those ruining the country and cities. The shifts between our country and my kingdom remain.
Retain all earlier remissions and additional gifts confirmed. The repeated granted wording does not establish that every benefit had previously been delivered.
Retain permission to strike own coinage as currency for the country. The clause authorizes minting; it does not itself report actual production of a particular coin issue.
Retain freedom of Jerusalem/holy places and continued possession of prepared weapons and held strongholds. The different categories of grant remain explicit.
Retain every royal debt and future dues remitted from now for all time. No narrower tax class is inserted to simplify the broad promise.
Retain honour conditioned on gaining the kingdom, for Simon, nation and temple, with glory across the earth. Repeated glory remains rather than a single generalized favour.
Retain year 174, ancestral land and all forces joining so that few remain with Tryphon. The all/few opposition is the narrator’s account, without numerical reconstruction.
Retain Antiochus pursuing and Tryphon fleeing to coastal Dora. The second he contextually shifts to the fugitive, not Antiochus fleeing his own pursuit.
Retain awareness of gathered evils and troop desertion as the reason for flight. The source’s evils image is not reduced solely to one named battle.
Retain one hundred twenty thousand warriors and eight thousand cavalry at Dora. No plausibility-based reduction of the selected figures is made.
Retain encirclement, naval attack, pressure from land/sea and no exit or entry. The paired directions preserve the full blockade claim.

Retain Numenius and companions arriving from Rome with letters for kings/countries. The following letter is embedded evidence within the narrative, not an independently authenticated archival original.
Retain Lucius, Roman consul, and King Ptolemy. No surname or modern chronological identification is supplied to the named official.
Retain Jewish envoys as friends/allies, renewal from the beginning and their commissioning by Simon/people. The paired friendship/alliance terms remain.
Retain the gold shield of one thousand minas. The source unit remains, without a modern weight or value conversion.
Retain prohibitions on harm, war against people/cities/country and aiding their attackers. The recipients’ obligations remain separate rather than a general nonaggression paraphrase.
Retain the Roman decision to accept the shield. Acceptance is stated separately from the envoys’ presentation.

Retain extradition of pestilent fugitives to Simon for punishment according to their law. The diplomatic description and legal reference are not converted into present-day advice or a modern treaty rule.
Retain recipients Demetrius, Attalus, Ariarathes and Arsaces in order. No regnal numbers are added.
Retain the full geographical recipient sequence from Sampsame through Cyrene, including Spartans, islands, cities and regions. The mixed categories are not forced into one type of polity.
column3: Sampsame and the other place forms remain provisional; no modern identification or alternate spelling is certified by this comparison.

column2: Retain a copy written to Simon the high priest. The plural writers are not silently reduced to a newly named single author.

Retain the inherited second-day expression, continuing assault, engines and Tryphon’s enclosure. Day is supplied for the elliptical second expression, and forces interprets the hands used in the assault image.
column3: Does the second expression mean second day or a renewed siege phase? How literally should bringing hands against the city be represented? Both remain open.

column2: Retain two thousand chosen allied fighters, silver, gold and ample equipment. The numerical contingent and material assistance remain distinct.
Retain refusal, annulment of all prior agreements and estrangement. Them broadly includes the offered assistance; the Greek neuter object does not specify only the men.
Retain Athenobius as a royal Friend and the claim to Joppa, Gazara and Jerusalem’s citadel as royal cities. The grouped city designation is not corrected by the translator.
Retain accusations of devastation, a great blow and control of many places. These remain the king’s allegations rather than an independent territorial judgment.
Retain demand for seized cities and tribute from places outside Judea. The outside-border qualifier is essential and not omitted.
Retain two separate five-hundred-talent amounts and conditional war threat. Do not merge them into one five-hundred payment or add an unexpressed currency conversion.
Retain Simon’s glory, gold/silver display, retinue and envoy’s astonishment before delivering the message. Display is provisional for the vessel-rack/cupboard term.
column3: What specific furnishing or display apparatus does the noun denote? The current general rendering does not establish its construction.

column2: Retain Simon’s denial of foreign seizure and claim of ancestral inheritance unjustly taken. Unjustly renders the without-judgment idiom provisionally, without inventing a historical court ruling.
Retain present opportunity and holding fast to the fathers’ inheritance. The reiterated inheritance claim remains inside Simon’s response.
Retain Joppa/Gazara as demanded places, their harmful impact and the offer of one hundred talents. The offer is distinct from the king’s two five-hundred demands.
Retain the envoy’s silence, angry return, complete report and king’s great anger. The two anger responses belong to distinct people and remain.
Retain Tryphon boarding a ship and fleeing to Orthosia. No fate beyond this escape is supplied here.
Retain Cendebaeus’s coastal chief command and infantry/cavalry grant. The title is a provisional functional rendering, not an assertion of a modern rank equivalence.
Retain encampment opposite Judea, rebuilding Kedron, strengthened gates and war against the people, while the king pursues Tryphon. The two simultaneous assignments remain distinct.
Retain Jamnia, provocation, invasion, captivity and killing. The escalating actions are not softened into neutral border patrol.
Retain Kedron rebuilt, cavalry/forces posted and sorties on Judean roads under the king’s order. No additional road names or raid targets are inserted.
